title: SolutionArchitectEvaluatorItems
description: Output shape for L0-solution-architect-evaluator. Re-emits the generator's corrected items with an evaluation block attached, plus a Confluence artifact. Scores are read from the paired generator's evaluation.md at runtime — this schema does not duplicate the rubric.

chunks_published.description: Confluence writer calls that succeeded; 0 in a preview run

hallucination.description: Lower is better — this is a rate, not a pass score

citation_completeness.description: null if the generator's evaluation.md marks this N/A

findings.description: Problems found only — a check that found nothing gets no entry

check.description: Which evaluation.md Quality Gate or Reflection Checklist item this finding is about

coverage_check.description: Set-membership results for each completeness dimension — counts and missing ids only, never the full entity/edge/req text

components_in_target.description: APP-2 components plus platform components the target names

capability_classes_in_target.description: REQ-PLT-* demands for a target in the current template; § 4.2 classes for the older layout. null only when the target has neither

registered_copies_in_target.description: Registered read models plus captured snapshot values the target names

checks_not_applicable.description: Checks that could not run because the target lacks the section they read. Their counts are null

cross_section_consistency.description: Each flag is true only when its check produced no fail finding

plt6_status_matches_satisfaction_index.description: No SATISFIED REQ whose PLT-6 row is PARTIAL/NOT PRESENT, and no NOT_YET_BUILT REQ whose row is AVAILABLE

snapshots_have_int1_edges.description: Every snapshot-register entry is captured over an existing INT-1 edge and INT-2/INT-3 contract or topic

producers_consumers_in_target.description: Every producer/consumer in DAT-2, INT-2 and INT-3 is a target context or component with an INT-1 edge

cycle0_decisions_in_scope.description: Every Available PLT-6 row meets a Cycle 0 test judged against the fixed exit-proof list, never the document's own

integrity_mechanisms_independent.description: Every integrity concern has a mechanism an administrator cannot undo, and its write step is named

no_degraded_copies.description: No degraded mode shows another context's remembered value; every snapshot sits on the table it describes

summary_sections_match_body.description: Every Section 12 SD row and Section 2 technology-view row names a body decision with the same status tag

final_decision.description: approved = passed with no fixes needed; fixed_and_approved = failed findings were fixed and now pass; escalate_to_hitl = could not fix to a passing score
